facts.fact: Tris 被送出 Erudite 总部时问时间，得知已是六点，她在楼里待了一小时
facts.anchor: he tells me it’s six o’clock—an hour after I first arrived in Erudite headquarters

facts.fact: 巷子尽头转身走开的那个人影是 Eric，Dauntless 的领袖
Tris 看不出 Eric 刚收进枪套的枪是麻醉针枪，还是从墙上取走的致命武器
facts.anchor: the gun he’s now holstering has the iridescent stripe of a needle gun

facts.fact: 她第一次想到，能拿到墙边武器的并不只有 factionless
facts.anchor: I never considered that the factionless aren’t the only ones with access to the weapons at the wall.

facts.fact: 她追着第四节车厢跑，因为 factionless 的应急包放在那一节
facts.anchor: I run alongside the fourth car, since it’s the one that will have the factionless emergency bag inside it.

facts.fact: Eric 在前面上了第一节车厢，比她先上车
facts.anchor: He gets on ahead of me, in the first car.

facts.fact: Eric 对那个看不见的人说他们有一个硬性的截止期限
在通往下层 Pit 的石路上，一只手抓住她的肩膀把她扳过来
facts.anchor: Then a hand grabs my shoulder and wrenches me around.
